publication.scope: Only the faithful vectorized versions of these previously approved project designs; unlicensed Escher reproductions are excluded.

rendering.roi_format: [x, y, width, height] in source-image pixels
rendering.repetition: The original full compositions and cover crop are preserved. No claim that the raster source edges or its animal silhouettes tessellate the plane.
rendering.nfc: Only stable preset selectors and appearance parameters are shared; no image pixels, source crop, hash or generation prompt are sent.
rendering.representation: Self-contained SVG Bézier paths faithfully traced from the approved PNG sources; no embedded raster images.
rendering.appearance: Mosaic colour and material follow the selected background. Elemental effects are a separate local overlay; no independent mosaic finish or ink colours.

nature-fish.label: Peces
nature-fish.title: Peces — diseño para Txoka

generation.description: New all-over composition of koi-like fish with long flowing fins in a fine black-and-ivory engraving treatment. Generated for Txoka without naming an existing artist or using reference artwork.

nature-fish.rights_note: Generated for this project. No claim of exclusive copyright, legal clearance guarantee, or attribution to M. C. Escher.

vectorization.method: Faithful two-ink Bézier tracing of the approved PNG; no redrawing or replacement of its composition.
vectorization.tool_license: GPL-2.0-or-later (Potrace tool; source artwork rights provenance is retained).

validation.method: Rendered SVG at source resolution using system librsvg; compared thresholded pixels against approved source.
validation.note: Bézier smoothing and removal of tiny components change some fine edge samples; these metrics do not claim pixel identity.
